Data Flow Diagrams: What Kiro Draws For You

Kiro draws your architecture before you write a word of code.
Inside design.md, Kiro generates data flow diagrams automatically.
They show how information moves between your services and components.
It's documentation you'd normally have to draw yourself, done for free.
